notes.title: Ven VR Adventure - Play NOW on Oculus Quest and Oculus Quest 2
notes.content:
Hello,

We are pleased to inform you that [b]Ven VR Adventure[/b], our immersive and challenging 3D platformer game for virtual reality, is finally [b]available [/b]on Oculus Quest! Our game is available for $29.99.

[b]OCULUS QUEST STORE PAGE:[/b]
https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/3327317663977182/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40091719/fc48bfa5a696101819afd97c7d9ff4a377dfa363.jpg[/img]


After 2.5 years we are happy to release our game on Oculus Quest and Oculus Quest 2.


Oculus Quest 2 version has a lot of improvements: 
[list]
[*] Dynamic Shadows.
[*] A bit of dynamic lighting.
[*] High Quality textures.
[*] High Quality lightmaps.
[*] Levels are sorted according to difficulty (Chapter 2 says hello).
[*] Camera has new functionality, that you will be able to go backwards.
[*] Adjusted camera, so you don’t need to always watch down.
[*] Bug fixes etc.
[/list]


We plan to update the steam version after release, so stay tuned and support us by sharing our game!
